replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Any block is okay but please do not use these; Fences, Cobblestone Walls, Stairs, Slabs, Flowers, Ladders, Tall Grass, Dead Bushes, Cactus, Pressure Plates, Trapdoors, Levers, Gates, Anvils, Water, Lava, Carpets, or Cobwebs.

replies.author: Refisio
replies.body: Why Stairs? I can understand the other blocks, except for those (and slabs). Is it trouble with the METADATA files that alter the positioning of the stairs?
replies.body_tagged: Why Stairs? I can understand the other blocks, except for those (and slabs). Is it trouble with the METADATA files that alter the positioning of the stairs?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Stairs, when placed incorrectly or next to slabs/dipping down, they will glitch the player out heavily to the point where they can hardly move (hence them falling into the void).
